calibration_step.instruction: Chew naturally 3 times, pausing for 5 second between each time.
Swallow naturally 3 times, pausing for 5 second between each time.
Look up and down with your eyes 5 times. Do not move your head. Pause for 1 second between each movement.
Look left and right with your eyes 5 times. Do not move your head. Pause for 1 second between each movement.
Blink naturally 5 times, pausing for 1 second between each blink.
Rest for 2 minutes. Keep your eyes at the center and do not move. Blinking is allowed.
Close your eyes for 2 minutes. While closed, keep your eyes at the center and do not move.
Calibration - face. Click "Next" to continue
